Keywords: Lebanese citizens, minors, exemption from attendance, exemption from fees
Content:

Lebanese citizens that request a new passport should show up personally at the competent regional center of general security, according to their place of residence, having in hand an application that’s been filled, and certified by the competent mayor.
Minors aged 7 years or younger have to accompany their parents to the mayor’s office, but don’t have to show up at the general security center. Both parents should sign a letter of consent at the mayor’s office, and convey their request to the general security. One of the parents can go on his own to the general security office, if the other parent signed the letter at the mayor’s office.
Minors aged between 7 and 15 years old, have to show up at the general security with their parents. Both parents should sign a letter of consent at the mayor’s office, and convey their request to the general security. One of the parents can go on his own to the general security office, if the other parent signed the letter at the mayor’s office.

The individuals paralyzed or sick that are unable to leave their place of residence, or the hospital, are exempted from this requirement, but a written request has to be provided by the concerned citizen, or his parents, or the directory of the association in charge of the individual in question. A medical report issued by the competent doctor or the concerned hospital is also required. This request is addressed to the general director of general security. The latter takes a decision on the subject, if he agrees, digital fingerprints of the concerned citizen are taken, and his passport is issued.
The individuals having in hand a social security card, are exempted from paying additional fees (4,900,000 L.L.) to receive the passport immediately, when applying at the General Director department.

URL:https://www.general-security.gov.lb/en/posts/71
Title: Passport of an adopted, born in special circumstances child or a citizen without a family name
Category: Passport of an adopted, born in special circumstances child or a citizen without a family name
Keywords: documents, minor, passport, adopted, special circumstances child, citizien without a family name 
Content:
The requested documents:
 

Investigation report done by the Interior Security Forces
 

A certificate of birth that conforms to current regulations
 

A civil status extract for the child bearing his adoptive name
 

A document signed by the orphanage waiving the child
 

An agreement issued by spiritual religious court concerning the adoption
 

A marriage attestation procured by the adopting family
 

The approval issued by local governmental entities
 

A medical attestation that underlines the infertility of one of the spouses
 

An extract of judicial record for both the kid and the adoptive parents
 

A certified copy of the passport held by the adoptive parents
 

An attestation that underlines the fact that both the parents and the orphanage didn’t receive any form of revenue from the above mentioned procedure
 

The approval issued by the ministry of internal affairs and the municipality
 

An attestation of baptism for the adopted kid and the adoptive parents
 

An accreditation issued to the orphanage
 

A proxy done by one of the parents to the other, if one of them is unable to show up
 
NB:
 

The above-mentioned documents have to be authentic, and the copies should be certified
 

The procedures required in such a case are held in the general secretarial office of the general security, by the adoptive parents. The documents are then transferred to the bureau of passports, naturalization and foreign affairs. 
Child born in special circumstances An individual registered under his mother’s surname, without a mention of his father’s true identity (considered anonymous), that conveys a request of obtaining a passport, has to respect the following criteria:
A passport for an adult applicant (hyperlink)
 
A passport for a minor: his mother should show up at the competent general security bureau, where she is interrogated, having in hand the requested documents, including the judicial decisions that led to the registration of the child under the mother’s name
 
The final decision is issued by the general director of the general security.
  A citizen without a family name Citizens that do not have family names, have a right to a passport according to the information provided by the identity card or an extract of civil status
The label: “----“is transcribed under the family name, regardless of the foreign language

URL:https://www.general-security.gov.lb/en/posts/86
Title:Certifying copies of passport pages
Category: Certifying Passport
Keywords: certification, passport
Content:

In order to get one or more pages of his passport certified, the concerned citizen must show up at the competent general security regional office, having his passport in hand as well as a photocopy of the latter, including the pages he wishes to certify, and a tax stamp of LBP 1000.
The concerned citizen could convey the above-mentioned request at the Lebanese Passports Department, a regional department or LibanPost company.

- The individual in question has to be present personally, or represented by a member of his family, to export his passport. A proxy has to be issued by a notary.
 
-     The invoice issued by the post company underlining the address of the sender and the receiver of the passport
 
-     A certified copy of the proxy as well as that of the receiver’s passport
 
NB: If the country in question has a diplomatic entity in Lebanon (an embassy – a consulate), then exporting the passport is not allowed except in some specific justified cases.

- The owner of the passport has to show up personally, or be represented by a member of his family. A guarantee delivered by the notary giving the representative the right to export the passport can be however used.
 
-     The invoice issued by the post company underlining the address of the sender and the receiver of the passport 
 
-     A certified copy of the proxy as well as that of the receiver’s passport.

NB: the representative shipping the foreign passport, that has no family ties with the owner of the hereby passport, has to be provide an invoice underlining the entry of the passport on Lebanese grounds

Potential beneficiaries

- Travel agency 
- courier companies 
- Travelers
When it comes to the passports sent by Liban poste, or poste express or via a traveler, the interested party must show up at the general security at the bureau of press. A representative could replace him if the latter is a member of his family or if he holds a proxy done by the notary if it is a foreigner.

For travel agencies that plan to ship passports, the following documents are required:
1-   A certified copy of the extract of civil status held by the owner of the agency
2-   An extract of commercial register
3-   A proxy signed by the owner or the representative at the mayor’s office in favor of the agency

section: For the individual planning on shipping his passport with another traveler
text:
1-   The owner needs to show up in person at the department of press – general security, with the traveler concerned, to convey the pre-mentioned request.
2-   The traveler has to have his airplane ticket in hand to underline the date of his departure, as well as proof of an entry visa and a stable residence in the country of destination
3-   The traveler is held responsible in case of losing the passport, on in case of any illegal use of the latter
Passports exported by the embassy or the consulate are exempted from any authorization given by the general security.

Citizens must declare the loss of their passport in person at a regional office of general security, having in hand documents of identification
If the citizen is a minor, his legal guardian must declare the loss, having in hand documents of identification that underline his appointment as a legal guardian. If the minor is aged 15 years or less, his presence is a must, in such as case.
If the concerned party is a public figure whether political, spiritual, or a military entity, the declaration can be made by an appointed delegate, having in hand an authorization issued by the Operation Room.

The same above-mentioned procedures are applied for stolen passports, with the exception of an additional document required:
A certified copy of the investigation report done by the ISF internal security forces\
The general directorate of General security informs citizens of the necessity to declare a lost/stolen passport even if they don’t intend to apply for a new one.

URL: https://www.general-security.gov.lb/en/posts/11 
Title: Biometric Passport
Category:Biometric Passport
Keywords: documents, fees, minors, renewal, biometric
Content:
Requested documents:

The adequate application for passports format A4 (10 years) issued by the competent mayor according to the place of residence.
Lebanese ID card OR/AND an extract of civil status (whether the Lebanese citizen is applying for the 1st time for a biometric passport or not). Follow this link for more information: https://www.general-security.gov.lb/ar/posts/408
A new colored photo ID photo on a white background, 4.5 x 3.5, on which the name of the individual appears, as well as the number and place of registered residence, signed and certified by the mayor.
The old passport if the latter is available, as well as a copy of the pages that are not empty.
The fees related to this application.
When it comes to members of the general security, whether active or retired, and the applications sent by their families, they can hand out only one document of identification (identity card, or extract of individual civil status, which dates back to one year at the most). The term family in this context is used to refer to kids, wife / husband and parents.
Minors aged 3 years and less are granted a passport (5 years) based on the extract of civil status issued 3 months ago at the most, a copy of the latter, and the above-mentioned documents. The authorization of the parents or the legal guardian is requested.
 
Remarks:

The id photo has to conform to current regulations.
The regular substitution of the biometric passport can be requested by the interested party.
When it comes to minors aged 18 years or less, the authorization of both parents is requested, their signature is certified by the competent notary or by a general security officer.
If one of the parents or both die, or in case of a divorce, the legal guardian has to grant his authorization and sign. The latter is appointed via a judicial decision, or a proxy that conforms to current regulations.
If the interested party (above-mentioned) is not able to show up and grant his approval, he can eventually assign a representative via a proxy that conforms to current regulations, done via a competent notary.
If the legal guardian is abroad, he will have to sign a proxy that is certified by the Lebanese embassy, and the ministry of foreign affairs, or via a notary if there isn’t a Lebanese embassy in the country of residence. (The prefecture has to certify the proxy as well)
The validity date of the travel authorization is set to 3 months.
The validity date of the proxy is set to one month.
The proxy does not include minors born after its issuance.
Minors (that are married, widowed, or divorced) do not need any authorization.
The copies attached to the application have to be in an A4 format.
The interested party that wishes to substitute his passport, has to be photographed every time.
If any legal measures are taken against him, the legal decision must be attached to the application as well.
Fees:

Document requested	               Fees
Passport valid for 5 years	        6,000,000 L.L
Passport valid for 10 years	        10,000,000 L.L
Passport – first class - 5 years 	30,000,000 L.L
Passport – second class - 5 years 	20,000,000 L.L
Passport – first class - 10 years 	60,000,000 L.L
Passport – second class - 10 years 	40,000,000 L.L
 
NB: To receive the passport immediately, the interested party can apply at the department of public relations. An additional fee of LBP 9,800,000 will be however requested.
